bio: Set against the backdrop of the Allgäu Alps, this beautiful building houses both a hotel with tasteful and comfortable guestrooms, and a cosy and stylishly furnished restaurant. Affording stunning views, the terrace is naturally a wonderful spot in summer! The food is excellent and made with ingredients that are sourced exclusively from the region. Dishes such as Arctic char confit served with morels and peas are complemented by your choice from the excellent wine list....
